entities.summary: Varun Aditya, is an Indian wildlife photographer and environmentalist. His work has garnered recognition, highlighted by his first-place achievement as the National Geographic Nature Photographer of the Year in 2016. In addition to his photographic accomplishments, Varun Aditya engages in research about animals and nature through his photography.
